subject: Keeping pilot live while PO clears — short-term credit request
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@aurelialabs.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Keeping pilot live while PO clears — short-term credit request

Hi Samir —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. The team at Aurelia ran the sentiment extraction demo against your latest clinical notes dump and the initial signals look promising. I know finance/legal are still working through the PO — totally understandable.

To avoid the pilot falling offline while procurement completes, would Aurelia accept a one-time temporary credit to preserve the sandbox for 7 days?

Proposal (flexible):
- 10,000 token credit applied to the pilot environment (non-billable, one-off)
- Condition: PO submitted or signed intent within 7 days from acceptance
- If PO is not submitted in that timeframe, credit will be retracted and we can pause the environment

If that sounds workable I'll loop in our sales ops manager to generate the approval paperwork. I attached the short demo recording you asked for (MVP-demo-recording.mp4) and can share a short checklist for the environment handoff.

Appreciate the urgency — tell me what will move the procurement needle and we'll accommodate where possible.

Best,
Priyom Das\Account Executive, Redwood Inference
pri.yom@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0128

Subject: Re: Keeping pilot live while PO clears — short-term credit request

Priyom —

Thanks for the quick follow-up and the recording — that helped a lot. We're at the tail end of a vendor review and the PO needs sign-off from procurement and legal (they're requesting standard security artifacts and an indemnity clause tweak). That pushed our timeline out by at least a week.

A short-term credit would be very helpful. Two questions: 1) can the credit be limited to the environment we provisioned (so nothing spills into production), and 2) what internal approvals do you require on your side? Our procurement team is okay with a conditional letter or an emailed confirmation of credit terms rather than an immediate contract amendment.

CC'ing Natasha (ops lead) so she's in the loop.

—Samir
Samir Patel\Head of Data Science, Aurelia Labs
samir.patel@aurelialabs.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 17:04:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Keeping pilot live while PO clears — short-term credit request

Looping in Marissa to confirm what we can approve from a manager / sales-ops perspective. Quick read: deal DL-2027-1453, mid-market pilot (Aurelia), procurement/legal asking for typical SSO/KMS notes and a PO.

My suggested approach:
- Offer a scoped, environment-bound credit (yes — restrict to the sandbox project and API key)
- Default ask: 7 days, 10k tokens (matches typical warm-start requests)
- Require a confirmation email from the buyer stating expected PO submission date; list today as acceptance date
- If they need longer, escalate to revenue ops for a one-time exception (we can present metrics).

If Marissa signs off I can prepare the one-pager and have S/O issue a provisional credit note. Thoughts?

Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Karthik / Priyom —

Approved: provide a 7-day sandbox-only credit of 10,000 tokens for Aurelia Labs, conditional on the buyer emailing a PO submission ETA within 48 hours. This is a one-time, non-billable concession to preserve pilot momentum.

Operational notes for sales ops: please attach the completed credit-approval-form.pdf to the HubSpot deal record (DL-2027-1453) and generate a provisional credit note tied to the sandbox API key. Mark expiration date as 2027-04-10 23:59 UTC.

Priyom, you can send the confirmation email template to Samir and Natasha; after we receive the PO ETA we mark the provisional credit live.

We will email procurement's PO ETA within 24 hours (Natasha will follow up with the exact date). Please send over the confirmation template and any required form so we can HQ procurement sign-off it up the chain.
